next.reason: 1985: "the value of the data item referenced by identifier-2 or identifier-5 ... must be equal to an occurrence number of an element in a table"; 2023: "the data item shall have a positive value. If the data item does not have a positive value, the EC-RANGE-PERFORM-VARYING exception". Basic, TIMES, UNTIL and VARYING semantics carry over. The 1985 occurrence-number and index-range requirements become a positive-value rule with an exception, and BY may be omitted (default 1).
